Beneath {wiki:Villa Scapula}, a ruined mansion in the swamp north of Venore, lurks the {creature:Black Knight}, former commander of the Royal Army. Cross the caves full of skeletons and bonelords, pass the level 50 door, kill the knight and collect the {item:Crown Armor} and the {item:Crown Shield} from the dead trees in his room.
The former commander of the Royal Army was abandoned by his own kind and now has scores to settle with them...
Villa Scapula (ruin in the swamp north of Venore)
Level 50 to pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} (50+ recommended).
only if the cellar door is locked; it's in the dead trees west of the villa
In the final room, kill the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} first: they have little health.
If the cellar door is locked, first pick up the {item:Key 5010} from one of the two dead trees west of the villa.

Leave **Venore** by the **northwest** exit and head northwest towards the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}. It's the most direct route; you can also cross the amazons' camp from the east side of {wiki:The Big Old One}. Stop when you find a large ruined building sunk in the swamp.
If the cellar door is locked you'll need the {item:Key 5010}. Use one of the two {item:Dead Tree|dead trees} **west** of the villa to get it.
Use the dead tree (Dead Tree) to get the Key 5010

Go down the stairs to the building's cellar. Here you can find {creature:Bat|Bats} and a {creature:Slime}. Go to the **south** end of the cellar, where there's a door. If it's locked, open it with the {item:Key 5010}. Go in and go down the stairs inside.
Use the Key 5010 to unlock the door
Cellar route map (1/4): yellow = start, green = destination
On this floor you can find one of the scrolls. Go down again.
Follow the cave. When it splits in two, pick either side — both lead to the same place. At the end of the cave, jump into the hole.
Follow the cave **south** and, at the end of the path, use the {item:Rope} to climb up.
Follow the cave again as far **south** as possible to a room with a few {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}. Jump into either of the two holes in this room.

On this floor there are 4 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (in the northwest and south rooms, in the east room and one to the north, next to the stairs). Head **east** until you hit a wall and then follow the cave **north** to the stairs. Go down.

To the **north** is a level 50 {item:Gate of Expertise}. Pass it and continue north. In the big room there are 1 {creature:Skeleton}, 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and 1 {creature:Wyvern}. Kill them and step into the teleport to the **north**.
Map of the big room after the level 50 door
The teleport that leads to the Black Knight

The teleport takes you to a circular room with the {creature:Black Knight}, 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a few {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}. Kill the bonelords and scorpions first (they have little health) and then the Black Knight.
Black Knight room: yellow = start, white = Black Knight spawn, green = trees with the reward, red = teleport back, cyan = Secret Service Quest objectives
The {creature:Black Knight} is the quest's strongest enemy. Bring enough potions.
Head **south**. In the 4 corners of the room there are {item:Dead Tree|dead trees}: the **two southern ones** have the {item:Crown Shield} and the {item:Crown Armor}. The other two are empty.
Leave through the teleport on the **south** side of the room: it takes you back to the floor you were on before.
Back to the surface and Venore

Retrace the cellar route (maps 1 to 4): pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} again, go up the stairs from the Bonelords floor, use the {item:Rope} on the hole in the skeleton room to climb up, go down where you climbed up with the rope, use the {item:Rope} again on the hole you jumped into at the end of the cave and climb the stairs of the two cellars up to Villa Scapula. Then head back to **Venore** to the **southeast**, along the same Amazon Camp route.
Without a {item:Rope} you're stuck on the lower floors: don't lose it.
Anyone doing the {wiki:Secret Service Quest} also has to come here: either to kill the Black Knight, or to take an item from one of the two {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed doors} south of this room.
Also known as the Crown Set Quest.
